name: Open Sesame
teaser: A tool for developers (and cheaters) to open locked doors, safes, etc. without requiring the key

name: Map Editor Lite
teaser: Map Editor Lite is a server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone create and share custom map content - using an in-raid editor and simple JSON packs, no programming required.

name: Dev Tools
teaser: A testing kit for mod work: stand in the fire while you read your logs, mag-dump without reloading, and watch every bot on the map through the walls. For building mods, not for beating raids.

name: MagicBullet
teaser: Outgoing bullet and melee damage multiplier for the local player only. Bots keep vanilla damage.

name: Cobra's SPT Explorer
teaser: A read-only SPT database explorer and in-raid helper for mod developers and players.
